data.sub: Railway mein station master ke 1,265 padon par bharti, 25 November tak aavedan.

chat.say: Station master ban kar train time par chalaunga!

data.asar: Railway ki taiyari karne walon ke liye bada mauka aaya hai.
data.caption:
Railway mein naukri ka sapna dekhne walon ke liye aayi badi khabar! 🚆

• Railway mein station master ke 1265 padon par bharti
• 25 November tak kar sakte hain aavedan
• Chayan prakriya mein kiya gaya hai bada बदलाव

Station master banne ka mauka hath se mat jane dena!

Apne us dost ko tag karo jo railway exam ki taiyari kar raha hai.
